headgroup_score: Strongest distinct matched Diagnostic_HG or Diagnostic_B product.
lcb_score: Strongest composition-specific LCB-H2O or LCB-2H2O product at or above 1% of the original base peak.
other_score: Distinct auxiliary peaks strictly above 0.5% of the original base peak, capped at three eligible channels.
admission: Two distinct Y/Z peaks including Y0 or Z0, two distinct B peaks, NeuAc, and an extended HexNAc signature for GM1, GD1 and GT1.
